sessions.title: Push + Glute + Close
sessions.goal: One session covering the rest of the week: dip push, real hip-thrust loading, upper balance, light single-leg, hang/skill — not a double-day cram.
sessions.success: Hip thrust actually loaded. Dip variation honest. Skill hang/pike done. Leave the block complete without frying yourself.

blocks.title: Warm-up
blocks.note: Open hips and upper back before dips, thrust, and skill.

items.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
items.focus: Glute on, ribs quiet.

items.name: Glute Bridges
items.focus: Prep for hip thrust. Ribs down.

items.name: Bodyweight Reverse Lunge check
items.focus: Front shin vertical. Any under-kneecap pinch → goblet later.

items.name: Wall Pike Hold or Wall Handstand practice
items.focus: Stacked shape. Hollow-ish ribs. Soft breathing.

items.name: Passive or active hang
items.focus: Shoulders quiet. Build toward 60s long-term.

items.name: Dip support or box/bench dip prep
items.detail: 2 × 15–20 sec support or 1 easy prep set
items.focus: Shoulders packed. No dumping into the joint.

exercises.name: Dip or Bench Dip
exercises.prescription: BW, assisted, or feet-elevated bench dip as needed
exercises.focus: Controlled depth you own. No shoulder pinch. Name the variation in notes.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.focus: Hips square. Pull elbow to hip. Pause.

exercises.name: Barbell or Dumbbell Hip Thrust
exercises.prescription: Load it — BB 40–60 kg or DBs ~20+ kg each. 15 kg last logged was too light
exercises.focus: Chin tucked. Ribs down. Full glute squeeze at top. No lumbar overextend.
exercises.note: Structural priority for this closer. Glutes should own the set.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Landmine or Cable Press
exercises.prescription: Moderate — same effort as a solid DB press set
exercises.focus: Front glute on. No rib flare. Press clean.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.prescription: BW–12 kg DBs. Prefer reverse lunge if check clean; else goblet 16–20 kg and note it
exercises.focus: Front shin vertical. Controlled knee to floor. No BSS.
exercises.note: Knee cleared. Still cue shin-vertical. Name variation if you switch.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.focus: Walk tall. Soft ribs. Grip finishes clean.

items.focus: Pelvis stacked. Controlled rotation — no lumbar flop.

items.focus: Glute drives the kickback. Ribs quiet.

items.focus: Move from hips, not spine. Low back stays calm.

items.name: TFL / Glute Med Stretch
items.focus: Breathe into the outside hip. No forcing.
